item.title: Polyglot Unconference 2026 Recap
item.description:
I attended the Polyglot Software Unconference in Vancouver on Saturday, October 17, 2026. This was my second time attending. I posted my recap of the first one a year late, so this time I’m trying to make it right by posting my recap sooner.

Late arrival

I’m kind of embarrassed to admit that I arrived late. But I have a good excuse: the night before, my husband and I went fishing at this beautiful lake. We didn’t catch anything, but it was still worthwhile. We got back home really late, at around 10 pm, so in the morning I overslept.

item.title: (Belated) Polyglot Unconference 2025 Recap
item.description:
I attended the Polyglot Software Unconference in Vancouver on Saturday, October 11, 2025, at UBC Robson Square. Yes, you read that right: 2025. This post is indeed late.

Recently I received a message from Tavis Rudd, the unconference organizer, about the upcoming Polyglot Unconference 2026, happening on Saturday, October 17. That reminded me that I have notes about this event that I haven’t really shared or posted. I thought they would serve as a useful insight for those who haven’t decided about the upcoming event yet. (If you’re a PyLadies Vancouver member, there’s a discount code; details are on the PyLadies Vancouver blog.) So, here goes.
